title: Meta Releases Muse Wonder, Its Most Capable Models So Far, for Developers First
summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on October 12, calling them its most capable models to date. Muse Wonder is available through the Meta Model API at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output; Wonder Full only through Muse Code subscriptions. Meta says Wonder will come to the Muse app later, starting with subscribers.
body:
Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on October 12. Meta calls them its most capable models to date, built for personal and professional agentic tasks. They build on Muse Spark, the model that has powered the Meta AI app since April.

How to get it

For now the new models are for developers. Muse Wonder is available through the Meta Model API at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output, with a 1-million-token context window. Muse Wonder Full is not in the API: it is available only to subscribers of Muse Code, Meta's coding product, on its Power Usage ($50 a month) and Maximum Usage ($200 a month) plans.

What about the Meta AI and Muse apps

Meta says Muse Wonder will soon power experiences in Muse, its personal agent app, and will roll out first to subscribers. It has not said when it will reach the Meta AI assistant in WhatsApp, Instagram or Facebook, which still runs on the Muse Spark family.

Why it matters

With Wonder, Meta is competing at the top end against Claude, GPT and Gemini rather than only offering a free assistant inside its apps. For most people nothing changes yet; for developers it is a new option to compare on price and quality.
